resources.string: Scroll Counter only notices when you scroll or open supported social media apps (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and others). It uses this to count your scrolls, show a small check-in card every 5 scrolls, and take you back to the home screen once your daily limit is reached. It does not read text, messages, or anything shown on your screen, and all data stays on your device.
